description: Feature 2 — session-only resume upload that drives interview context. Add a backend resume-parsing endpoint (PDF/DOCX/TXT -> text -> optional AI distillation) and frontend resume controls that send the parsed profile on the /ws/interview start frame's existing candidate_profile field, in memory only (no DB row, no disk beyond transient BytesIO). Depends on FEAT-001: it reuses interview.js (start-frame/candidateProfile accessors), index.html Interview tab, preload.js, and server.py — so it runs AFTER FEAT-001 to keep one coherent working tree. The candidate_profile wire path already exists end to end; this feature only adds the parse endpoint and the UI that fills candidate_profile. Grounded in the verified source: preload bridge is exposeInMainWorld('electronAPI',{...}) aliased as `const api = window.electronAPI` (index.html line 436); #iv-resume already exists as the 'Resume listening' control so resume-document controls MUST use the iv-cv-* prefix; ws_interview applies candidate_profile only on a fresh session (full Stop->Start), not on a bare reconnect.
steps: requirements.txt: add pypdf==5.1.0 and python-docx==1.1.2 (exact pins; leave pytest commented). Install both into /Users/pranay/Desktop/Pranay/Projects/In-Queue/screen_shot/.venv.

Create resume_parser.py (new): ResumeParseError; constants RESUME_DISTILL_INPUT_BUDGET=6000, RESUME_RAW_PROFILE_BUDGET=8000, RESUME_DISTILL_PROMPT (from design.md). extract_text(file_stream, filename, content_type)->str: .pdf via pypdf.PdfReader over a BytesIO (concat page.extract_text()); .docx via python-docx (join paragraph texts + table cell texts); .txt/text/plain via UTF-8 then latin-1 fallback; unknown -> ResumeParseError; use BytesIO throughout, no temp file on disk. distill(text, ai_module)->(profile, distilled, truncated) called only on non-empty text: if distill requested AND ai_module.is_configured(), one ai_module.ask(text[:RESUME_DISTILL_INPUT_BUDGET], system_prompt=RESUME_DISTILL_PROMPT) -> (profile, True, len(text)>RESUME_DISTILL_INPUT_BUDGET); on AIError/not-configured -> (text[:RESUME_RAW_PROFILE_BUDGET], False, len(text)>RESUME_RAW_PROFILE_BUDGET). Never log file bytes or extracted text.

server.py: add api_resume_parse() route POST /api/resume/parse (multipart, field 'file') with the pinned order: (1) require file (missing->400); route-level size check request.content_length > 8*1024*1024 (->413); extension/content-type whitelist .pdf/.docx/.txt (else->415). (2) text = resume_parser.extract_text(...) (corrupt->422). (3) empty/whitespace text -> 422 and return immediately (BEFORE distill). (4) distill = request.form.get('distill','true').lower() != 'false'; if distill -> profile,distilled,truncated = resume_parser.distill(text, ai_helper) else profile=text[:RESUME_RAW_PROFILE_BUDGET], distilled=False, truncated=len(text)>RESUME_RAW_PROFILE_BUDGET. (5) return {success:true, profile, chars: len(text), truncated, distilled, filename}. Do NOT set app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH']. No DB write, no disk persistence.

preload.js: inside the electronAPI object add parseResume(file, distill=true) building a FormData (append 'file' with file.name, append 'distill'=String(distill)) and POSTing to ${BACKEND_URL}/api/resume/parse, returning res.json(); extend askText(text, tone, recordId, language) to include language in the POST body only when defined (3-arg callers unaffected).

index.html: in the #view-interview .actions row add resume-document controls under the iv-cv-* prefix: #iv-cv-input (hidden <input type=file accept='.pdf,.docx,.txt'>), #iv-cv-btn (triggers input), #iv-cv-label (status), #iv-cv-clear. In initInterviewUI(): wire upload to api.parseResume, store the returned profile via IV.setCandidateProfile(...) in a JS var (NOT localStorage), add candidateProfile: IV.getCandidateProfile() to startOpts(), show 'Resume loaded (N chars)' from response chars and append ' (truncated)' when response.truncated, Clear resets to '' ; when a session is live show 'Resume will apply when you (re)start listening' (wired to Stop/Start, not reconnect). Extend the manual-retry askText call to pass the detected question language.

tests/test_resume.py (new): extract_text on an in-test .txt and a generated minimal .docx (and PDF guarded by pytest.importorskip); empty text -> ResumeParseError/empty; distill with a stub AI vs AI-off (raw fallback) asserting the (profile,distilled,truncated) tuple; > RESUME_DISTILL_INPUT_BUDGET input -> truncated is True; the distill boolean rule (absent->true, 'false'->false, '1'->true); route POST /api/resume/parse via Flask test client with a multipart .txt -> success:true, profile, chars==len(extracted) pre-truncation, truncated present; oversize->413, bad type->415. All AI stubbed; no network; clean up temp files.

From overlay_app, `node --check preload.js && node --check interview.js && npm test` all pass (FEAT-001 frontend tests still green).

Frontend: `node --check preload.js interview.js` ok; `npm test` 16/16 pass. pypdf==5.1.0 + python-docx==1.1.2 installed into screen_shot/.venv (pulled lxml 6.1.3). Both repos on ObservationsAtul. interview.js was NOT modified — FEAT-001 already shipped setCandidateProfile/getCandidateProfile + the start-frame candidate_profile path, so FEAT-002 only consumes them.

BACKEND new files/changes:
- resume_parser.py (NEW): ResumeParseError; constants RESUME_DISTILL_INPUT_BUDGET=6000, RESUME_RAW_PROFILE_BUDGET=8000, RESUME_DISTILL_PROMPT. extract_text(file_stream, filename, content_type)->str (reads stream into BytesIO once; .pdf via pypdf.PdfReader concat page.extract_text(); .docx via docx.Document paragraphs + table cell texts; .txt/text/* via utf-8 then latin-1; unknown->ResumeParseError; NO temp file on disk). distill(text, ai_module)->(profile, distilled, truncated): if ai_module.is_configured() -> ask(text[:6000], system_prompt=RESUME_DISTILL_PROMPT) => (profile, True, len(text)>6000); on any Exception/AIError/not-configured -> (text[:8000], False, len(text)>8000). Never logs bytes/text.
- server.py: defensive `import resume_parser` (None on failure). NEW route POST /api/resume/parse -> api_resume_parse(): pinned order (1) require file (400), route-level request.content_length>8MB (413), extension whitelist .pdf/.docx/.txt (415); (2) extract_text (ResumeParseError or any Exception -> 422, message never leaks content); (3) empty/whitespace text -> 422 BEFORE distill; (4) distill = request.form.get('distill','true').lower() != 'false' -> resume_parser.distill(text, ai_helper), else profile=text[:8000]/distilled=False/truncated. (5) returns {success, profile, chars: len(text) (PRE-truncation), truncated, distilled, filename}. MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH NOT set app-wide (route-level only). No DB write, no disk.
- requirements.txt: added pypdf==5.1.0 + python-docx==1.1.2 (exact pins); pytest stays commented.
- tests/test_resume.py (NEW, 16 tests, all AI stubbed with local StubAI classes separate from the shared FakeAI; fully offline): extract_text txt(utf-8 + latin-1 fallback)/docx(generated)/pdf(pypdf writer blank page, importorskip)/unsupported-type; distill configured vs AI-off(raw) vs AI-raises(raw) + truncated flags for both budgets; route success(no-distill, chars==pre-truncation len), missing-file 400, bad-type 415, empty-text 422, oversize 413 (real >8MB body), chars-is-pre-truncation + profile capped + truncated:true.

FRONTEND changes:
- preload.js: added parseResume(file, distill=true) INSIDE exposeInMainWorld('electronAPI',{...}) — builds FormData (file+file.name, distill=String(distill)), POST ${BACKEND_URL}/api/resume/parse, returns res.json(). (askText 4-arg form already landed in FEAT-001; untouched.)
- index.html: in #view-interview .actions row added iv-cv-* controls (#iv-cv-input hidden file input accept='.pdf,.docx,.txt', #iv-cv-btn triggers it, #iv-cv-label status, #iv-cv-clear). In initInterviewUI(): el refs cvInput/cvBtn/cvLabel/cvClear; upload handler calls api.parseResume, on success IV.setCandidateProfile(res.profile) + label 'Resume loaded (N chars)' (+' (truncated)' when res.truncated), on failure/unreachable shows error + resets label; clear resets profile to '' and label to 'No resume'; both call noteResumeApplies() which shows 'Resume will apply when you (re)start listening.' only while a session is live (NOT localStorage, NOT a live-mutation frame). startOpts() now includes candidateProfile: IV.getCandidateProfile() (rides the existing start-frame candidate_profile on the next Stop->Start). cvInput.value reset after each pick so the same file can be re-selected. Answer tab untouched.

WIRE/CONTRACT: POST /api/resume/parse multipart field 'file' + optional 'distill'; response {success, profile, chars, truncated, distilled, filename} or {success:false, error} with 400/413/415/422/503. Profile flows ONLY via the pre-existing /ws/interview start-frame candidate_profile on a full Stop->Start (new session_id); no new WS frame, no backend persistence, no {type:'profile'} control frame.

DEVIATIONS: (1) The PDF extract_text test uses pypdf's own PdfWriter blank page and asserts extract_text returns a str (not specific text), because authoring real text into a PDF needs a renderer (reportlab) that is not a project dependency; the scanned/empty-PDF->422 path is covered separately by the route empty-text test. No production-code deviation.
